description: Builds a complete HTML landing page for an audit when the user asks and their plan covers it. No design is needed first: the designer sets the look and works the audit's fixes in. Set keep to improve the page they already have and keep its look. Pass concept_id only to build from a design the user saw with get_concepts. Use check_balance for coverage and quote only returned purchase prices when a purchase is needed. Returns build_run_id. Use get_build with wait:25; completion requires artifact_ready. Do not publish or share the page without the user asking.

concept_id.description: Optional. From get_concepts, to build from that design.

direction.description: Optional plain-English steer for the build.

keep.description: Improve the page they already have and keep its look, instead of a new one. Takes no concept_id.

name: build_page
title: Build a landing page
